_comment: ★채널 브랜드 레지스트리 — 영상별 프로젝트가 아니라 채널 자체가 project_dir 이다. 마스코트 몽이는 모든 영상에 재등장하므로 채널 레벨에 고정하고 assets/characters/ 에 커밋한다(코드로 다시 만들 수 없는 기준물). 실행: .venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/assets/turnaround.py channels/dalttokki --no-style-ref ※v2 = 2026-09-06 재생성본(측면 패널의 눈이 떠 있던 결함 수정). v1은 폐기.

mongi.name: 몽이
mongi.anchorProp: a small wooden Korean mortar (jeolgu) and pestle standing right beside the rabbit
mongi.lock: A baby moon-rabbit named Mongi. A small round plush-soft rabbit, chest-high proportions of a toddler animal — big round head, short round body, very short limbs. Fur is soft cream-white with a faint warm ivory tint, slightly fluffier at the chest and cheeks. LOP EARS: both ears hang DOWN along the sides of the head like a lop-eared rabbit, drooping past the cheeks — never standing upright, never pointing up. Pale dusty-pink inner ear. Tiny pink triangular nose, no visible teeth. Eyes are always CLOSED, drawn as two simple downward crescent curves, with soft round pink blush on both cheeks. Small round cotton tail. Wears nothing at all — no clothes, no hat, no ribbon, no collar.
negatives: no clothing or accessories of any kind
ears must never stand upright — they always droop down
no bold black outlines, no thick dark lineart — edges are soft and painterly
not a Western Easter bunny, not Peter Rabbit
negatives_turnaround: the mortar and pestle must appear in every one of the four panels, on the same side of the rabbit
in EVERY panel including the 90-degree profile, the eye must be drawn as a closed downward crescent line — never a round dot, never an open eye, never a visible pupil
